body: Ramesh, ORS demand is up 40% this season (Multi-pharmacy aggregate Apr 2026). Your CTR is 4.5% vs peer 3.8%, showing strong engagement. Move ORS and sunscreen to the front counter and shift cold/cough to the back shelf to match the trend. Shall I draft the shelf plan for you?

Dr. Bharat, your calls dropped 50% in the last 7 days. Your profile has 980 views, 46% below peers, and no active offer. I can draft a Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 offer to boost traffic. Shall I draft it for you?

Priya, Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic here. Yaad hai aapka last visit 12 May 2026 tha, aur aapne 4 baar cleaning aur whitening karwaya. Aapka 6-month cleaning 12 Nov 2026 ko due hai. Book karein: Wed 5 Nov 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov 5pm. Price ₹299. Batao kaunsa slot aapke liye best hai 😊

Dr. Meera, the Dental Council of India circular dated 2026-11-04 sets a new IOPA dose limit of 1.0 mSv, effective 2026-12-15. E‑speed film still meets the limit, but D‑speed does not; digital RVG sensors are unaffected. I can run a quick audit checklist to confirm your X‑ray setup and update your SOPs before the deadline. Shall we schedule the audit?
